work_completed: When `criticality.yaml` is present, `launcher.py` now reads the shared record folder once per worker launch (`_launch_records`). A record file there that is not JSON refuses the launch, even when no probe record exists anywhere (P-td5-1). The probe records are taken from the launch root, then from every other existing folder that a `record: gov-launch` file names as its `root`, where the record's ticket is the given id, the ticket's `id` or its `wbs_id`, for any role (`_probe_roots`). Named roots that are missing, are files or are not absolute paths are skipped. The records form one set by root-relative path: the launch root's copy wins, then the other roots in sorted order (`_probe_files`, P-td5-2). The promotion's `record` is the root-relative path. A refusal for a record under another root names both its root-relative path and its full path. The review count (6.1) uses the same single read. With no `criticality.yaml` nothing is read (1.4 unchanged). A second commit puts back the old comparison of the record's own `session_id` against `--resume`; my first commit had changed that edge case.
